script: Am I the jerk My girlfriend's sister wants to move in and I won't change my mind.. There's a high probability that my girlfriend's sister will want to move in for two years, until she finishes her master's degree. GF asked me the other day, "What would you say if X moved in with us?" I said, "Absolutely not." She then asked, "How would you react if my brother wanted to do that?" I replied, "I hadn't thought of it that way." They didn't see it as a problem because they used to live together as adults. Even their mom is already prepping for this, planning her life around it. We ran into X today. She asked the same question. I refused, same exact line. I tried to dodge the topic and threw in the commute angle: "You're going to have a 120‑km ride, 2 hours each way. Winter is brutal." I am like, "I've done that, no joke." (Seriously, I know the grind.) She said she'd contribute to bills and pay "rent." That's not my issue. I didn't want a 30‑year commitment that'd clip my privacy. The money would just funnel into extra mortgage payments. I find it not worth the stress. Having her in the house would lead to constant drama. But here's the thing: I am scared they'll see me as the villain, and I'll lose the respect I've built with my girlfriend's side of the family. If this doesn't work, I'll lose my personal space, my peace of mind—like, my entire vibe. I am literally in a bind. Then it hit me: every time I think I am in control, I am actually letting the situation slide. I am like, "I am better than this mess." But wait— it gets worse. I keep hearing their arguments about "family" and "support," and I am left wondering if I am the only one who's… (the story stops mid‑thought, tension hanging in the air).
